identification: Small colour print (photomechanical reproduction, flat sheen, no brushwork) of a 17th-century Italian Caravaggesque scene: a soldier in armour and red cloak, a bearded old man, a bare-breasted woman reaching across, and an infant lying on a cushion; subject reads as a Mars/Venus/Cupid allegory (or a Judgement of Solomon type), artist of the original not pinned down. In a heavy ornate gilt composition (gesso or resin) frame with swept rococo shell-and-scroll corners and a beaded inner slip, 28 x 33 cm overall, image about 13 x 18 cm. Armitage estimate A$40-60.
